cases.name: Betty Stotts
cases.about: She was a ticket teller at the Bolero Drive-In in Kerrville, TX.
cases.narrative: He entered the ticket booth where she worked at a drive-in, beaten her with a blunt instrument, raped her, stabbed her repeatedly, and set her on fire.

cases.name: Linda Vanessa Lopez
cases.about: On her entry at Break The Silence Against Domestic Violence website, a family member wrote: "Linda was a beautiful, funny, energetic, young lady, just starting her life." Her obituary said: "She had been a resident of Kerrville for many years. Miss Lopez was a graduate of Tivy High School, Class of 2008. She was a great mother, daughter, granddaughter, niece and cousin. Miss Lopez was a member of the Impact Christian Fellowship of Kerrville and was loved by all that knew her."
cases.narrative:
Police say they were responding to a reported disturbance near a Guadalupe River park in Kerrville when they were confronted by the armed teenager. The police statement says he emerged from a vehicle, refused demands to drop his handgun and pointed it at the officers. Police then shot him several times. Ramirez was pronounced dead at Peterson Regional Medical Center in Kerrville.

About the same time, police went to a house in Kerrville and found Linda Lopez dead of gunshot wounds.
